description.en: Sets the game sub-phase, the number that tracks the player's progress through the story (e.g. 10010010). Map and event scripts compare it with CMND_GET_GAME_SUB_PHASE. Use the ev_main helper SetGameSubPhase, which also replaces the NPCs and updates the objective.

true once set.
null if the script system is not ready or no argument is given.
